entries.original:
Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
\(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy

\[
[h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
\]

Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
\(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
\(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
\(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.

Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
\(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
algebraically closed.

entries.correspondence: All p,K,lam,V,x,y,h,v and arbitrary admissible lattices are quantified as parameters. Field and finite-dimensional complex module instances supply the original structures; H001 retains prime characteristic, 0≤lam<p, the integer-valued dimension lam+1, all three Chevalley commutators, nonzero highest-weight vector and original complex irreducibility expressed as bottom/top for invariant complex subspaces. This is equivalent to the sl₂ action because its Chevalley generators satisfy the presentation and span the Lie algebra; the same generator stability characterizes its invariant subspaces. The simultaneous ℤ/ℂ basis is existential at arbitrary finite cardinality; such a basis is exactly the original free lattice spanning V. The new parameters A,B are uniquely the restrictions of all divided powers: original admissibility constructs them, while their inclusion equations recover stability under every generator and hence Uℤ. Thus universal quantification over these data neither loses nor adds lattices. VK is the actual M⊗ℤK; T010 checks that its transported K action is exactly on the second factor and that map f id intertwines with Id⊗f. T011 identifies A₁,B₁,A₁B₁-B₁A₁ with the actual x,y,h restrictions. Consequently Nontrivial VK is precisely nonzero and the final three stability antecedents are exactly those of the target. Stability under these generators implies and is implied by stability under their K-linear span, including characteristic two. No algebraic closure, h≠0 or positive-lam assumption appears. Nonnegativity recovers (ell:ℤ)=lam in both directions of the natural-index identification.
